h1: Custom Clear Lotion for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom clear lotion in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Clear lotion offers a versatile, unscented base that works well for any workplace or event. Unlike colored or scented options, clear lotion blends seamlessly with your brand's logo without competing for attention. It's ideal for safety managers looking for a hypoallergenic hand care option or HR directors seeking gender-neutral gifts. Decorate with a subtle screen print or an embossed label for a clean, professional look that keeps your brand top of mind.
heroAltText: Custom clear lotion bottles with white labels and blue logos arranged on a wooden table
